keisha_marketing: Final preflight for Monday's announcement (sending 09:45 PT). Need: one-line headline, single bench stat for hero, final docs URL, rollout start time, and sales tag confirmation. @adrian_engineering @maria_docs @oliver_salesops :eyes:

adrian_engineering: Rollout plan looks good. Start 08:50 PT with 10% canary for 12m, then 40% for 18m, full by 09:45 PT if healthy. I'll pause on error >0.5% or p95 up >22%. No infra holds.

maria_docs: Docs are live at https://docs.redwood-inference.com/releases/v2-8. Full changelog & migration notes: https://docs.redwood-inference.com/releases/v2-8/changelog. I added a short FAQ on quantization quirks.

maria_docs: Migration snippet for the email (copyable):
```
{"inference": {"quantization": "opt-in", "profile": "compact-adaptive"}}
```

adrian_engineering: Bench highlight: internal chat trace shows up to 31% token cost reduction and median p95 down 13%. Recommend marketing copy: "reduces token cost by up to 31% on common chat workloads" (add bench link).

keisha_marketing: We'll use "up to 30%" to be conservative in headline. Headline options: "v2.8: faster responses, lower token costs" or "Save up to 30% on chat inference with v2.8". Leaning second for homepage hero. Need hero PNG and alt text.

oliver_salesops: Salesops: web form will tag inbound leads as "v2_8_launch" and route to queue "inbound-launch". I'll smoke test post-send and confirm here.

adrian_engineering: Perf PNG uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/marketing/v2-8-hero.png Alt: "p95 latency and token cost: v2.7 vs v2.8". CSV attached.

release-bot: Release pipeline started by adrian_engineering at 1945678960. CI: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/59012 :gear:

adrian_engineering: Canary 10% stable at 08:52 PT, moving to 40%. No regression signals. Monitoring dashboards green.

release-bot: Release completed at 1945679020. Status: success. Full rollout finished.

keisha_marketing: LIVE  announcement sent at 09:45 PT. We'll include docs + changelog, migration snippet, hero chart, bench callout ("up to 30% depending on workload"), and webinar CTA (Wed 10am PT). Oliver, please confirm tag verification when ready. Thanks all! :tada:

oliver_salesops: Confirmed post-send: leads are tagged "v2_8_launch" and routed to "inbound-launch". Smoke test passed.
